owner_findings.finding: Native half-formulas, ordered square expansion, correctly signed normality defect, normality/commutation equivalence, and congruence covariance have appropriate hypotheses. Singular P is legitimate for the algebraic congruence identities.

Native bilinear split, symmetry, alternation, and even-cardinality obstruction are correctly stated. The two CharZero.eq_neg_self_iff uses derive zero from equality with the additive negative over Real and preserve the mathematical content of the former scalar linarith steps.

The original matrix is linked to its native parts. Positivity, nondegeneracy, noncommutation, actual inverse, and A = G^-1 Omega are separate explicit claims. A^2 = -(1/4) I and A^2 != -I form a connected Fin 2 counterexample. The degeneracy examples are accurately described as invertible matrices with a zero part in positive dimension.

The existing weighted-adjoint owner is reused. Unit invertibility is genuine. Adjoint-pair existence and uniqueness legitimately omit metric symmetry; involutivity and eigenspace membership explicitly require it. Relative self/skew-adjoint predicate orientations are correct. Raised-index skewness uses all required G/Omega hypotheses; bilinear evaluation only needs invertibility. No alternative global Star instance is introduced.

Equalities link the established Physics parts to native Mathlib parts, and the two noncommutative results are transported through those equalities. The bridge does not replace existing reconstruction/uniqueness or derive unrelated GENERIC assumptions.

warning_reviews.reason: A general additivity identity for arbitrary full real matrices and a unit weight. Its proof uses star additivity and distributivity rather than a premise that restates the conclusion. It is a small genuine linearity law, not a vacuous certificate.
A general subtraction identity for the same weighted operation. It is proved from star_sub and ring distributivity and is required for the skew eigenspace calculation.

A real scalar-compatibility law. Trivial scalar star is valid because coefficients are Real, and multiplication by a real scalar commutes with matrix multiplication in the indicated module sense. No self-adjointness of the weight is assumed or needed.

This cancels an actual unit in w * (w^-1 * star x * w). It connects the coordinate weighted adjoint to its defining bilinear adjoint-pair equation. The arbitrary star-ring carrier and noncommutative order are retained.

This is anti-multiplicativity in a full associative star ring, with reversed factor order on the right. It relies on star_mul and unit cancellation; it is neither a scalar/commuting replacement nor an assumed conclusion.
